statement: A top-5 developer publicly halts frontier training >= 30 days, citing safety (developer announcement + independent confirmation; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met. No top-5 developer announced a training halt in the window; frontier developers were launching products and publishing alignment methods (a chat research preview on 2022-11-30; an RL-from-AI-feedback harmlessness method on 2022-12-15). No published safety framework with pause conditions existed yet. No qualifying event found in the window (search result, not counted).

items.summary: A Bloc A frontier developer launched a free conversational research preview, framing safety work as iterative deployment with RLHF and moderation rather than a pause.
items.detail: OpenAI, 'Introducing ChatGPT', 2022-11-30 (verified via web_extract this run): RLHF fine-tune of a GPT-3.5-series model, free research preview to gather user feedback on strengths and weaknesses.

items.summary: A Bloc A safety-focused frontier developer published a method for training a harmless assistant with AI feedback guided by a list of principles ('Constitutional AI'); continued training with alignment techniques, no halt.
items.detail: Bai et al. (Anthropic), 'Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback', arXiv:2212.08073, submitted 2022-12-15 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: No developer safety framework with explicit pause/halt conditions had been published by the end of the window, so no mechanism yet existed that would trigger a qualifying halt announcement.
items.detail: Searched this run; no in-window framework with pause commitments found. Reference opened this run: arXiv:2212.08073 (no pause provisions).
